final: WITH g AS (SELECT ID, AVG(HGB/(HCT/100.0)) AS a FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID), m1 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM g), k1 AS (SELECT g.ID, g.a, g.a - m1.m AS d1 FROM g JOIN m1 ON m1.m IS NOT NULL WHERE g.a > m1.m), m2 AS (SELECT AVG(a) AS m FROM k1), k2 AS (SELECT k1.a, k1.d1, k1.a - m2.m AS d2 FROM k1 JOIN m2 ON m2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE k1.a > m2.m) SELECT AVG(a) AS avg_a, AVG(d1) AS avg_d1, AVG(d2) AS avg_d2 FROM k2
